name: Support capacity planner
why: Turns ticket data and a sales forecast into cost per ticket and hiring dates, the step before the hourly rota.

name: Support hiring date planner
why: Works out agents needed by month from a year of tickets, for staffing plans beyond next week's rota.

name: Get support and stock ready for peak season
why: Plans support hiring dates for a peak, matching the forecasting step in the staffing skill.

name: Define a customer support escalation agreement
why: Writes down who handles a stuck issue and when it moves up, alongside the escalation playbook prompt.

name: Get a stuck customer issue unstuck and close the loop
why: Unsticks one case with a fact check, an escalation brief and a reply that keeps its promises.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks every promise in a complaint reply before the owner gives the fresh yes to send it.

name: Monthly help centre keeper
why: Finds the questions help pages miss each month, the same run as the help centre and macro review.

name: Help article writer from support tickets
why: Turns a group of tickets on one problem into a help article, a common fix in the monthly report.

name: Support bot error reviewer
why: Reviews bot chats against approved help text, for the AI agent review in the monthly workflow.

name: Yes-later-no request sorter
why: Sorts merged feature requests into yes, later or no, the step after the voice-of-customer ranking.

name: Clear your support inbox and turn fixes into help pages
why: Clears a backlog and turns fixes into help pages when the weekly review shows the queue running behind.
